combo.description: Press your R, then prepare your Q, AA your target to leap towards them, use your E, W, and AA, then Q, AA, AA and AA to finish.
Use your R, then AA, E, W, and Q your enemy to get max stacks of your passive. Flash into the Brush and then AA, E and AA to finish.
Leap to your enemy with an AA. Then Flash back into a brush and E, W, Q and AA and E again to root your enemy.
Use your R, then Q, E, W, AA. E again, then AA and Q to finish.
As you leap to your target with an A, use your E then Q, AA, W, E again and AA to finish.
Leap with an AA and quickly E, W and Q, then Q again and AA to finish.
Start with an AA to leap to your target, use your Q, then E and W, AA, Q and AA to finish.
Use your E AA and Q, then W, AA, W again, and finish with a final AA.
